ideas.idea: Render the Catalogue list on the server or at build time instead of a browser fetch in useEffect
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs client-side, so crawlers without JavaScript never see the mugs.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page with links, plus Product structured data
ideas.why:
The catalogue shows only names as

elements, so individual URLs and Product markup would give each mug an address and machine-readable details.

ideas.idea: Say more about what you sell, such as price, sizes and shipping, in text on the Home page
ideas.why: This is plausible content advice, but it rests on a guess about what visitors would ask and not on anything the code shows.

ideas.idea: Declare the site's production domain so canonical links and a sitemap can be built
ideas.why: No domain appears anywhere in the repo, and canonical URLs and sitemap entries both need an absolute origin.

ideas.idea: Add per-page titles using a head helper, since the SPA shares one head
ideas.why: Both routes share index.html's single title, so a head manager would let Home and Catalogue have distinct titles.
